race.comment: THE JESTER'S SON (2) resumed in good touch when only 1L off the winner in a strong race. He'll need a touch of luck from the barrier, but ZJP knows him well and he does possess some good speed. Out to the mile is no issue and with improvement on the cards, he can go one better. MONTY ZOOMER (3) couldn't bring up the hat-trick to finish 1.3L off the winner last time out over 1400m. Can sit up front from the inside barrier and Riordan's claim is a bonus. Loves this track and trip and can make every post a winner. FRIAR'S LEGACY (9) is racing in good order, missing by 0.9L at Bunbury last time out in a CL5. He was a good winner here two back and steps out to the mile for just the second time. Faithfull hops back on board now and with no weight on his back, he makes plenty of appeal. CRUNCHY NUT (5) is third-up now and boasts a strong third-up record. Expecting improvement. OMERTA GRACE (11) comes right back in trip now and can feature in the finish.
